metadata.description: A suite of Claude Code plugins: house rules, a ticket-to-pull-request loop, a read-only audit of finished pull requests, a review gate, instruction-file maintenance, and auto mode trust for listed repositories.

plugins.name: rules
plugins.description: House rules for Claude Code sessions: one block in your CLAUDE.md, kept current, plus the Concise Plain output style, a refactor review against them and a handoff prompt skill.

plugins.name: loop
plugins.description: Plan, build, review and publish a bundle of tickets as one reviewed pull request per repository, resuming on the same branch when run again.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: A read-only, adversarial audit of finished pull requests that stops at a report, with an act step that commits approved items.

plugins.name: primer
plugins.description: Project instructions in the forms Claude Code loads: a short CLAUDE.md, path-scoped rules, nested instructions and skills, with auto memory promoted into them and a hook that checks every commit.

plugins.name: gate
plugins.description: Run code-review passes over a pull request, fixing what each pass finds, until a pass finds nothing left to fix.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Auto mode trust for the repositories you list: the classifier's entries in your user settings file, written by a script when you run /guard, each change shown before it is made.
